 Gamethread/How to watch Northwestern vs Rutgers: TV, radio, streaming, betting line, injury report
 The Wildcats are looking to become bowl eligible and move to 3-0 at Ryan Field.
 by Inside NU Archives Oct 24, 2026, 2:24 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Northwestern welcomes Rutgers to new Ryan Field on Family Weekend as the Wildcats look to become bowl-eligible. 
 Broadcast Information 
 Location: Ryan Field (Evanston, Illinois)
 Game Time: 11 AM CT
 TV: Peacock, NBCSN Extra
 WGN Radio 720 AM
 Streaming: Peacock
 Odds 
 NU -15.5, O/U 58.5 (via FanDuel)
 Northwestern Injury Report 
 OUT - DB Robert Fitzgerald, DB Josh Fussell, DL Brendan Flakes, RB Daniel Anderson, LB Max Mohring, LB Jason Reynolds II, DL Callen Campbell, LB Qayvier Johnson, OL David Anchondo, OL Ezomo Oratokhai, OL Jacob Miller, TE Chris Petrucci, TE Luke Dehnicke
 Rutgers Injury Report 
 OUT - DB Kaj Sanders, DB Kevin Levy, DB Zahmir Dawud
 GAME TIME DECISION - RB Antwan Raymond, WR Jourdin Houston, LB Ty Morris, RB Ja’shon Benjamin, DL Keshon Griffin
